sentences.text: 随着其为安然和世通所做的可疑会计处理曝光，该所于2002年年中倒闭。
sentences.evidence: The firm collapsed by mid-2002, as details of its questionable accounting practices for energy company Enron and telecommunications company WorldCom were revealed

sentences.text: 相关丑闻是2002年《萨班斯-奥克斯利法案》出台的因素之一。
sentences.evidence: The scandals were a factor in the enactment of the Sarbanes–Oxley Act of 2002.

sentences.text: 1913年，安达信与 Clarence DeLany 创办了 Andersen, DeLany & Co. 会计师事务所。
sentences.evidence: In 1913, Andersen and Clarence DeLany founded an accounting firm as Andersen, DeLany & Co.
